name: Exp_ChandelExitSign_ReOpen
summary: This EA implements the Chandelier Exit indicator signaling system with position re-opening capability. It generates trade signals based on the Chandelier Exit trailing stop mechanism and re-enters positions when trend signals re-appear after a close. The strategy follows trends using a volatility-based trailing stop derived from ATR.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了Chandelier Exit（吊灯退出）指标信号系统，并具备仓位重新开启功能。它基于Chandelier Exit跟踪止损机制生成交易信号，并在平仓后趋势信号再次出现时重新进场。策略使用基于ATR的波动率跟踪止损来跟随趋势。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于Chandelier Exit指标，这是一个由Alexander Elder提出的基于ATR的跟踪止损指标。入场条件：当价格突破Chandelier Exit上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空。出场条件：当价格触及Chandelier Exit跟踪止损线时平仓。仓位管理：支持重新开仓功能（ReOpen），即在趋势信号重新确认后可以再次进场，这是该EA的独特之处。资金管理方面，通过ATR倍数参数控制止损距离，止损宽度随市场波动率自适应调整。策略核心优势在于跟踪止损能根据市场波动率动态调整，既保护利润又给予趋势足够发展空间，但ReOpen机制可能导致在震荡行情中反复进出场产生较多虚假信号和交易成本。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is based on the Chandelier Exit indicator, a volatility-based trailing stop proposed by Alexander Elder using ATR. Entry conditions: go long when price breaks above the Chandelier Exit upper band, go short when price breaks below the lower band. Exit conditions: close positions when price hits the Chandelier Exit trailing stop line. Position sizing incorporates the ReOpen feature, allowing re-entry when trend signals re-appear after a stop-out, which is the EA's distinctive characteristic. Money management uses an ATR multiplier parameter to control stop distance, making stop width adaptively adjust to market volatility. The core strength is that the trailing stop dynamically adjusts based on volatility, protecting profits while giving trends enough room to develop, but the ReOpen mechanism can cause repeated entries and exits in choppy markets generating excessive false signals and transaction costs.

parameters.description_en: ATR multiplier, controls trailing stop distance

parameters.description: 是否允许在信号重新确认后重新开仓
parameters.description_en: Allow re-entry to add position in same direction

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 固定止损点数，0表示使用Chandelier Exit动态止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, limits max loss per trade

pros: 基于ATR的动态跟踪止损能自适应市场波动率，在趋势行情中有效保护利润
ReOpen机制允许在趋势延续时重新进场，避免错过大趋势行情
Chandelier Exit是经典且经过验证的技术指标，策略逻辑清晰易懂
pros_en: ATR-based dynamic trailing stop adapts to market volatility, effectively protecting profits in trending markets
ReOpen mechanism allows re-entry when trend continues, avoiding missing major trend moves
Chandelier Exit is a classic and well-validated technical indicator with clear and understandable strategy logic
cons: ReOpen机制在震荡行情中可能导致反复开平仓，产生频繁的虚假信号和交易成本
缺少明确的资金管理策略，固定手数交易未考虑账户风险比例
没有新增K线检测机制，可能在同一根K线上重复触发信号导致过度交易
cons_en: ReOpen mechanism can cause repeated open/close cycles in ranging markets, generating frequent false signals and transaction costs
Lacks explicit money management strategy, fixed lot trading does not account for account risk ratio
No new bar detection mechanism, potentially triggering repeated signals on the same bar causing over-trading
improvements: 增加震荡行情过滤器（如ADX或波动率阈值），在震荡市中禁用ReOpen以减少虚假信号
实现基于风险比例的动态仓位计算，替代固定手数，提升资金管理合理性
improvements_en: Add a ranging market filter (such as ADX or volatility threshold) to disable ReOpen in choppy markets and reduce false signals
Implement risk-percentage-based dynamic position sizing instead of fixed lots to improve money management rationality

risk_points: ReOpen机制可能在震荡行情中导致连续亏损和频繁交易成本累积
缺少新增K线检测可能导致同一K线多次触发交易信号
risk_points_en: ReOpen mechanism may cause consecutive losses and accumulated transaction costs from frequent trading in ranging markets
Lack of new bar detection may cause multiple trade triggers on the same candle
